verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single first-party line saying Cloudflare Images lets teams 'store, optimize, and deliver images,' which suggests a platform image pipeline. Nothing shows on-demand resizing, URL- or Worker-driven transforms, or how it integrates with Workers, and it reads as a separate sibling product rather than a built-in Workers feature. Missing for 10: documented on-demand resize/transform parameters, explicit Workers integration or binding for image transforms, format/quality optimization details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
